steps.content: When the shell blows up, the pickup truck almost gets blasted off. Before you're sent flying, Hella pushes you hard into the Nightmare's embrace, letting herself get thrown out by the impact.
Before you manage to catch her, two vehicles rush out of the thick smoke, hitting you hard from both the front and the back.
The vehicles have finally stopped. In a daze, you see a huge mob from the Legion arriving.
